Stocksbridge and Upper Don — Sheffield, United Kingdom

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

South Yorkshire Police recorded 315 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — an average of 5.7 per 1,000 residents a month, the 24th highest rate of Sheffield's 28 wards. The daytime score here is driven by vehicle crime (5), shoplifting (3), burglary (2); the evening/night score by violent crime (45), anti social behaviour (21), public order (8). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Stocksbridge and Upper Don safe?

Wandroz currently rates Stocksbridge and Upper Don in Sheffield as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Sheffield, both by day and after dark. This rating is derived from South Yorkshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Stocksbridge and Upper Don safe at night?

At night, Stocksbridge and Upper Don is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Sheffield. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Stocksbridge and Upper Don a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Stocksbridge and Upper Don's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Sheffield) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
